Saeed Arabha — Academic CV

Materials R&D · PhD in Mechanical Engineering, York University, completed September 2026

Selected research results

Boron nitride process development

In my doctoral work, I tested how gas preheating and operating conditions affected the concentration of boron nitride recovered after exfoliation. With nitrogen as the carrier gas, the recovered concentration rose from about 0.003 to 0.155 g/L. I calibrated the UV–vis measurements for each material by drying and weighing known volumes of suspension.

Thesis measurements

Shock-tube experiments

I contributed to the experimental investigation and validation of boron nitride exfoliation. At 1.4 MPa driver pressure, our team measured nearly four times the UV–vis absorbance at 350 nm with the tube open at the end compared with the closed configuration.

Peer-reviewed study
